description: Election Commission - Filling of a Vacancy in the Office of Member of the Kalawana Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Kalawana Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes, including the nomination and declaration of a new member to fill a vacancy caused by a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it deals with electoral matters, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authority elections.
